learnings: Weekly NDPSR prices follow the CME spot market with a lag: block (weight on same week -0.03, week before 0.21, two weeks before 0.77; typical miss 2.35%); barrel (weight on same week 0.05, week before 0.29, two weeks before 0.65; typical miss 1.85%); butter (weight on same week 0.19, week before 0.48, two weeks before 0.32; typical miss 1.87%); ndm (weight on same week -0.1, week before 0.15, two weeks before 0.87; typical miss 3.78%); whey (weight on same week -0.12, week before 0.16, two weeks before 0.82; typical miss 6.96%). So by the time a week is published, most of it can be predicted from spot prices already seen.
